footnote_text: 1.	The price reported in Column 4 is a weighted average sale price of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock. These shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $1.25 to $1.31, inclusive. The Reporting Person undertakes to provide to the Securities and Exchange Commission staff, the Issuer, or a security holder of the Issuer, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price within the range set forth in this footnote. || 2.	Includes 72,464 RSUs. Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock of the Issuer. 72,464 RSUs vest on the earlier to occur of (i) June 10, 2027, or (ii) the Issuer's 2027 annual meeting of stockholders and are settled within 30 days following such vesting date.
